name: Chicken and chorizo paella
title: Paella

steps.text: Make 850 ml hot chicken or vegetable stock. Cut the chicken into chunks, slice the onions and chorizo, crush the garlic.
1 tbsp olive oil in a deep frying pan, high heat. Brown the chicken all over (not cooked through), then onto a plate.
Heat down to low. Onions in and cook slowly until soft, about 10 minutes.
Garlic in, stir for 1 minute, then the chorizo until it releases its oils.
Stir in the turmeric, saffron and paprika, then the rice. Stir to coat for about 2 minutes.
Pour in the stock, bring to the boil, put the chicken back in. Simmer about 20 minutes, stirring now and then.
Give the paella a stir and check it is not catching.
Stir again. Cut the lemon into wedges and chop the parsley.
Peas in, simmer 5 more minutes until the rice is cooked and the chicken tender.
Season well and serve with lemon wedges and parsley. Enjoy!

ingredients: 2 chicken breast fillets, cut into chunks
850 ml hot chicken or vegetable stock
1 lemon, cut into wedges, to serve
½ small bunch of parsley, finely chopped, to serve
source: owner, Discord 11 Oct 2026 (BBC Good Food style recipe)
equipment: a large deep frying pan or paella pan
a measuring jug for the stock
